nodes.title: ArduPilot: Tailsitter VTOL tuning guide
nodes.where: notch first; pitch/yaw FF from log (start X=0.2), I = FF; D then P by oscillate-and-halve; roll like a quad

nodes.title: ArduPilot: Measuring vibration
nodes.where: VIBE < 30 m/s2 acceptable, > 60 m/s2 nearly always problems; Clip0-2 ideally 0, < 100 likely ok

nodes.title: ArduPilot: Vibration damping
nodes.where: gel pads or foam squares; off-the-shelf mounts are for 5-10x heavier boards; 'too much is as bad as too little'

nodes.title: ArduPilot: Dynamic harmonic notch
nodes.where: ESC RPM telemetry (INS_HNTCH_MODE 3) best, throttle-based (MODE 1) second; three harmonics usually safe

nodes.title: ArduPilot: QuadPlane weathervaning
nodes.where: Q_WVANE_ENABLE 1 nose into wind; GAIN start 1; active in QLOITER/QLAND/QRTL only, not QHOVER/QSTABILIZE

nodes.title: ArduPilot: Airspeed sensor
nodes.where: pitot out of the prop flow (about a foot from a nose prop); cover at power-up; ARSPD_AUTOCAL needs turns

nodes.title: ArduPilot: Magnetic interference
nodes.where: compass on a mast away from the PDB; twist pack-PDB-ESC wires; field rises with loop area and current

nodes.title: ArduPilot: Yaw and yaw control in Plane
nodes.where: no yaw rate stabilisation in FW modes except ACRO; yaw damper for fin-less wings via split surfaces; RUDD_DT_GAIN for twin throttles

nodes.title: Oscar Liang: fixing ESC desync; ModalAI note on low-KV motors
nodes.where: low-KV / high-inductance motors desync at high power: raise timing, lower ramp-up power, add a low-ESR capacitor at the ESC

nodes.title: TU Delft: origami-inspired drone landing gear drop tests
nodes.where: compliant gear cut peak impact force up to 75 % vs rigid; design by sink speed, load factor, stroke, energy, weight

nodes.title: Axial modulus of the 22 x 20 mm tube
nodes.text: The bought carbon tube has an axial Young's modulus of 100 GPa
nodes.basis: UD pultrusion 100-140 GPa (Epsilon); generic woven roll-wrapped hobby tubes are often 50-70 GPa. UNVERIFIED until I1's tube is bend-tested (T-J1-TUBE-BEND)

nodes.title: Printed motor mount mass
nodes.text: One printed PETG motor mount plus fasteners is 0.018 kg
nodes.basis: params.json fins allocation note: 4 motor mounts 72 g

nodes.title: APC 11x4.5MR static thrust per rpm^2
nodes.text: Static thrust of the 11x4.5MR scales as T = kT n^2 with kT = 7.254 N / 6000^2 rpm^2 (APC PER3 file)
nodes.basis: APC PER3 static rows: 5.02 N at 5000, 7.25 N at 6000, 9.91 N at 7000 rpm (within 2 % of n^2 scaling). APC predictions run ~10 % high on static thrust, so real rpm at a given thrust is slightly higher

nodes.title: Mode separation from forcing
nodes.text: A structural natural frequency must sit at least 20 % away from any steady motor forcing frequency (1P, 2P)
nodes.basis: common rotorcraft/drone practice for untested structures; the first mode of the fin-tube assembly is then confirmed by tap test (T-J1-TAP-TEST) and by the hover VIBE log

nodes.title: MH 45 quarter-chord moment coefficient
nodes.text: The MH 45 section with elevons neutral has cm c/4 = +0.0145 (2-D, Hepperle)
nodes.basis: Hepperle's MH 45 page; B2 replaces it with the XFOIL value at Re 2-4e5 and the elevon-deflected polars

nodes.title: Prop efficiency at ~1 N per prop, 15 m/s
nodes.text: The 11x4.5MR at 15 m/s and ~1 N thrust runs at J ~0.50-0.53, close to its zero-thrust J ~0.545, with eta 0.30-0.45
nodes.basis: APC PER3 rows: eta 0.17 at 6000 rpm / 14.7 m/s (0.32 N) and 0.54 at 7000 rpm / 14.4 m/s (2.38 N); 1 N lies between. The K09 REVIEW used 0.47; B4 interpolates the file properly

nodes.title: Fin side-area centroid vs CG
nodes.equation: arm = (x_le + x_te)/2 - x_cg ; ahead = (x_cg - x_le)/(x_te - x_le) ; arm_c = arm / c

nodes.title: Prop plane ahead of the CG
nodes.equation: arm = x_cg - x_prop ; arm_c = arm / c

nodes.title: Bare motor-tube first bending mode
nodes.equation: I = pi/64 (od^4 - id^4) ; k = 3 E I / L^3 ; m_eff = m_motor + m_prop + m_mount + 0.24 mu L ; f1 = sqrt(k/m_eff) / 2 pi

nodes.title: Motor forcing frequencies
nodes.equation: T_h = m g dl / n ; rpm = sqrt(T / kT) ; f1P = rpm/60 ; f2P = 2 f1P (2-blade) ; rpm_max from T_max

nodes.title: Tube mode separation from motor forcing
nodes.equation: sep = min |f1/f - 1| over f in {1P hover, 2P hover, 1P max}

nodes.title: Static margin trimmable with elevons neutral
nodes.equation: CL = m g / (0.5 rho V^2 S) ; sigma_trim = Cm0 / CL  (Hepperle: Cm = CL sigma for a plank)

nodes.title: Required disconnect rating
Fin centroid aft of CG
nodes.how: B3: AVL Cn_beta with fins, tubes and motors; must be positive with margin. Flight: FBWA yaw doublet on the twin.
nodes.note: Only 0.04 m (13 % chord): 40 % of the fin area is ahead of the CG. Weak weathercock stability in cruise is the likely mechanism behind the uncommanded FW yaw seen on all four student Box Kites.

nodes.title: Fin area ahead of the CG
nodes.how: Geometry from params.json; re-run after B3 moves the fins or the CG.

nodes.title: Prop planes ahead of the CG
nodes.how: B3: include propeller normal force (Ribner) in the AVL/hand pitch and yaw stability sums; 0.7 chord ahead of the CG is destabilising in both axes.

nodes.title: Bare tube first bending mode
nodes.how: Tap test of one fin + tube + motor assembly (T-J1-TAP-TEST); bend test of the tube for E (T-J1-TUBE-BEND).
nodes.note: Tube alone, clamped at the chord plane, motor at the tip. The bonded fin should raise this a lot; it must be measured.

nodes.title: Motor 1P at hover
nodes.how: ESC telemetry or bidirectional DShot RPM in the hover log; harmonic notch centre (INS_HNTCH_FREQ).

nodes.title: Blade-pass 2P at hover
nodes.how: FFT of the hover IMU log (ArduPilot notch review tool) shows the 2P peak.

nodes.title: Motor 1P at maximum thrust
Tube mode separation from forcing
nodes.how: C4 re-derives with the fin as a shear web; H1 tap test; hover VIBE < 30 m/s2 and Clip = 0 (SRC-J1-AP-VIBE).
nodes.note: FAILS on the bare tube: f1 sits 6 % from the hover 2P. Design the fin bond as the stiffener and move the mode.

nodes.title: Cruise lift coefficient at the gate
nodes.how: B1/B2 from the drag polar; airspeed log in cruise.

nodes.title: Static margin trimmable, elevons neutral
nodes.how: B2: XFOIL Cm at Re 3e5 with elevon deflection; B3: AVL trim at cruise CL. Flight: elevon trim position in FBWA.
nodes.note: FAILS against 5 %: the MH 45's +0.0145 trims ~2.7 % with neutral elevons at CL 0.54. Either B3 accepts ~3 % (Hepperle: 2-5 % typical for planks) or the elevons carry up-trim in cruise, which costs CLmax and worsens CR-A1-05 (transition gate).

nodes.title: Required disconnect continuous rating
nodes.how: 1.25 x the logged hover current (tethered hover, H1).

nodes.title: XT60 continuous rating
nodes.how: Maker sheet (35 A at 12 AWG, 85 K rise); Holybro says 30 A for < 60 degC rise. Bench: 30 A for 10 min, connector < 60 degC.
nodes.note: PROPOSED from the datasheet; margin +17 % on the Amass figure, 0 % on Holybro's. 12 AWG leads required.

nodes.title: XT60 one-minute rating
nodes.how: Compare with the logged full-throttle pack current on the thrust stand (4 stations) or F4's output cap.
nodes.note: FAILS the 120 A momentary case (4 x 30 A). F1: AS150U, or cap the momentary current in F4's output limits.

nodes.title: AS150U continuous rating
nodes.how: Open the Amass AS150U sheet before ordering (UNVERIFIED reseller value); bench 30 A for 10 min.

nodes.title: AS150U instantaneous rating
nodes.how: Same sheet; the pre-charge contact is the weak point (forum melt report): inspect after every full-throttle run.

nodes.title: Tap test, fin + tube + motor assembly
nodes.procedure: Clamp the finished fin at the spar saddle; tap the motor; FFT of a phone accelerometer or the FC IMU raw log; first mode must be >= 20 % from 1P/2P at hover and 1P at max.

nodes.title: Three-point bend of the bought tube
nodes.procedure: Span 0.8 m, load at centre in 0.5 kg steps to 4 kg, dial gauge; E = F L^3 / (48 I delta). Replaces ASM-J1-E-TUBE.

nodes.title: Connector heat run
nodes.procedure: 30 A through the mated pair for 10 min on the bench supply or thrust stand; IR thermometer; rise <= 60 degC.
